page.layout: One block: centred heading "INDEX" at top; then a table of three columns (reference, verse, page) with centred italic section headings ESAIAE, IEREMIAE, EZECHIEL; signature line "Xx 2" at the foot right.
page.notes: Heading "INDEX" is letterspaced capitals; "ESAIAE", "IEREMIAE", "EZECHIEL" are italic capitals. Page number is not printed; the signature "Xx 2" is at the foot right. Some page numbers are partly smudged by ink marks (e.g. p.499, p.349); readings are best estimates where the ink obscures digits.
